confidence_notes: Overall low. Restaurant and cafe anchors rest on undated aggregator and crowdsourced figures, reconciled by judgement. Cocktail and wine anchors come from a small Expatistan sample and a 2026 nightlife guide whose figures are not fully consistent. Hostel dorm anchors come from aggregator sites with mixed dates. Hotel anchors are weakly sourced: no reliable AUD average for Melbourne 2-star or 3-star rooms was found, so they rest mainly on general knowledge and low-end booking floors. FX: the only RBA observation I could verify is 20 March 2026, about seven months old, and I could not confirm a more recent RBA value. Refresh the FX observation before use. Anchors were converted from AUD estimates at 0.7088 USD per AUD.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution. Estimates are Melbourne-specific, drawn from Melbourne sources and adjusted by judgement for July 2026 winter pricing.
